title: Crystal Growth
description: Every transistor, laser and lens crystal starts as a seed dipped in its own melt. How fast it is drawn out decides what defects and impurities it keeps. Unlocks the Crystal Growth Furnace and its boules.

puzzle.goal: A crystal grows at its front only as fast as its latent heat L (per kilogram) can be carried away up the crystal, of density ρ, which conducts heat k watts per metre per kelvin down a gradient G. Write the growth speed v.
puzzle.name: Stefan condition at the front
puzzle.ask: Find v in mm/h for silicon: k = @{k} W/(m·K), G = 1500 K/m, R = @{R} kg/m³, L = @{L} J/kg.
puzzle.method: At the front the heat conducted away, k·G per square metre, must equal the latent heat set free, ρ·L·v.
